identity.scope: Read-only continuation evidence helper; sole design owner remains parent

result: Actual HOME has content-derived ensemble/thumbnail/assignment/phase information missing from R5 model. Existing actual four-kick frame is a narrow fixture, not populated whole-instrument proof.

contracts.data: Stored part IDs are9090,8081,BassA2,BassB3,BREAK4. Presentation order is[0,1,4,3,2]. Names come from current engine/sound identity, with short stable labels when full names exceed49px.
contracts.r5: SOURCE_PART mapping and laneName retain the order. A single global pattern scalar does not preserve independent per-part assignment.

contracts.data: For each displayed bank pattern and each part, project the whole stored valid length1..64 into8 bins with floor(step*8/length). Invalid stored lengths project as16; BREAK always uses16. Each bin keeps the strongest event across all relevant tracks/steps.
contracts.r5: home() hardcodes onlyP1 bins0,2,4,6; patternPicture() checks drum hits using floor((step-1)/2), so it assumes16 steps and has no other patterns or bass/BREAK rows.

contracts.data: Aggregate all11 drum voices. Default strength is127 on shared accent, otherwise saved accent_q7 (zero coerced to1). The first matching used T_VEL lane for pattern,part,(part<<4|voice),i0 supplies a valid1..127 step override; MOT_NONE/invalid falls back. Max aggregation occurs after velocity resolution.
contracts.r5: No saved per-hit velocity/accent data participates in HOME. Uniform marks are occupancy only, even when source projection differs by saved velocity.

contracts.data: HOME strength follows NOTE velocity and carries it through valid TIEs until REST. A leading wrapped TIE can inherit the last real NOTE. All-TIE and orphan-TIE runs remain silent. Velocity0 decodes as100; >127 clamps127. Pitch, transpose, BS_SLIDE, accent flag and release fraction are not encoded by this HOME projector.
contracts.r5: HOME has no bass step/gate/velocity data. Do not describe missing pitch/slide pictures as an existing visual feature that was removed: source HOME never showed them.

contracts.data: For nonzero strengthv: t=4+floor((v*12+63)/127); current assigned part uses t/16 of its part colour; noncurrent uses floor((t*9+8)/16)/16. Zero emits no mark. The1x3 column height is fixed; brightness, not column height, carries strength.
contracts.r5: Fixed-height uniform full-colour marks omit saved velocity and current/noncurrent brightness law.

contracts.data: part_used tests all64 drum bits or real G_NOTE anywhere, regardless current length; BREAK any stored step. pattern_used instead counts any nonREST bass gate, including orphan/allTIE. Thus physical used-pad dim is not identical to a sounding thumbnail. Off-loop hit can make part_used/current tick true while all projected bins remain zero.
contracts.r5: usedPatterns is a manually maintained list, not derived from shared pattern content. Do not silently equate assigned/current/used/audible.

contracts.data: Each used lane gets a current marker only when seq.ppat[part]==thatpattern; each part can differ. Queued909 target gets a separate frame at ui.frame&16 when different from current909. Chain endpoints underline their inclusive min..max interval. The printed pattern number uses seq.ppat[ui.part], while the normal HOME header and physical current pad anchor909.
contracts.r5: Only S.pattern and S.queued exist; no per-part assignments, chain or bank. The queue frame is static. It can highlight target content only after a real pattern store exists.

contracts.data: Each of five ensemble lanes reads its own current pattern. Drum occupancy ORs all11voices. Bass occupancy includes NOTE and valid carried TIE via note_start_of. BREAK uses raw16 step mask. Running drums/bass select base=eng_step[track]&~15; stopped shows first16. Current16-step lane is not the full-length8-bin thumbnail.
contracts.r5: home() ignores shared kit steps and hardcodes four909kick marks; all other rows remain blank after editing their actual model data. No bass/BREAK note store exists for HOME.

contracts.data: Each row uses its own eng_step[track] for a white underline when seq.playing, including empty/muted rows. Source whole-part mute dims left accent/name and occupied cells; thumbnail content retains stored part colours. Partial drum-track mute is not individually resolved by HOME occupancy; stored hit content remains.
contracts.r5: No lane playhead is drawn. Mute merely underlines the name and uses one S.muted array also used elsewhere for track mute, conflating distinct owners.

contracts.data: A live transient message replaces the header first (NEXT message includes a target miniature), except pickup remains a left hint with normal context. Normal HOME shows909 current+pending cue or SONG bar, tempo, metro phase, REC/save. ui.frame&16 changes pending cue ink even stopped; the separate PART header cue uses live-step phase. These paths must not be conflated.
contracts.r5: header() always uses one scalar pattern and adds a global patternPicture; lacks temporary NEXT message, all-part target preview, chain and per-part context. Future stopped/WAIT disposition remains a design intent, not current-source assertion.

contracts.data: HOME white/pad down cues all5parts; second overlapping white press defines chain, release clears chain-first owner. K4 on nonpart HOME cues allparts. K3 selects global part and thereby selected-part identity/colour; it does not rewrite current pattern assignments. OCTAVE chooses bank0/1. Black1..5 toggles whole-part mute or pending bar mute, not track selection.
contracts.r5: padDown sets S.queued=n+1, without bank, all-part ownership, chain/adoption. OCTAVE routing only handles drum SEQ. black() toggles S.muted immediately and does not represent pending mute.

contracts.data: SONG white/pad writes all5 pattern IDs to the selected bar through song_fill, marks dirty and advances selection if another bar fits. It does not cue playback. SONG black toggles selected-bar mute bits. PATCH held bypasses that branch and follows HOME pattern-cue/chain route. Valid selected bar and END/empty differ for current-pad priority.
contracts.r5: padDown HOME/SONG shared branch queues target in both. This packet records the contrast only; the incumbent Song helper owns full song/K5 contract.

pad_button_priority.rule: PLAY uses WAIT ui.frame&32 before normal playing909 step%4. REC reflects arm. PATCH on HOME/SONG or blinking active SONG elsewhere. View buttons identify current view; SCALE overlay; OCTAVE+ uses pattern bank in HOME/SONG; BT queued steady/failed bit2/unsaved bit8. Clip mode overrides PLAY/REC with host feedback.

pad_button_priority.owner: Normal HOME/SONG logical content when LIGHTS enabled
pad_button_priority.rule: Mark every pattern_used in current16-bank dim. HOME current909 bright even empty. SONG valid selected-bar909 bright; END/empty has no current fallback. HOME queued909 adds bright on bit8; no queued pattern blink on SONG. Logical black masks show whole-part/selected-bar mute but are not physical keybed lamps.

OR ui.keys after LIGHTS-gated content. A held physical pad can therefore be bright even LIGHTS off. Bright wins over dim through d&~k. Division owner can replace masks in its gated context; it is not a HOME owner.

Only16 logical white positions reach RGB pads. HOME hue is selected global part, not a colour per pattern or per contained part. Bright is RGB565 decoded channels>>1; dim>>3; off0. Binary buttons map panel.btn; fader-bank is separately set. No37-keybed lights, glow or redPLAY on SMK.

Clip mode owns pad colours/transport feedback instead of normal HOME. Development pad calibration can replace the normal frame path. Preserve these external owners; do not reinterpret their colours as local pattern-state acceptance.

canonical_input_requirements.required: Bank16 thumbnails plus each current per-part pattern (up to32): drum11x2word hits, accent2words, len/rate; bass64 steps note/flags/velocity,len/rate/dir/transpose; BREAK16rawsteps/rate/slice state; swing. Preserve unused fields as unknown when not present rather than zeroing them.
canonical_input_requirements.why: One canonical music store must serve HOME/SEQ/MIX and future arrangement, with stable source IDs.

canonical_input_requirements.required: The ordered lane pool used,pat,part,t,v,i,val64, including MOT_NONE; saved accent_q7; caller T_VEL identity. Preserve first-match ordering.
canonical_input_requirements.why: Saved strength must agree across thumbnail and selected-pattern edits without inventing uniform velocity.

canonical_input_requirements.required: seq.ppat5, pcue5 or sentinel, playing, external WAIT, eng_step5, seq.metro_view, ui.frame, ui.part, ui.pbank, chain endpoints, song mode/selection/bar assignments.
canonical_input_requirements.why: Selected, assigned/current, pending, playing cursor and stopped/WAIT are distinct state owners.

canonical_input_requirements.required: seq.mute, seq.vmute, queued_mutes, mute_q, vmute_q; selected Song bar mute; separate source bitmasks vs display indices.
canonical_input_requirements.why: Current mute, pending mute and track-vs-part mute cannot share one untyped array.

canonical_input_requirements.required: keyled, ui.keys, held pad logical key, clip/calibration/division owner flags and model gates, SMC connection; active view/overlay/help; save state and transient header message.
canonical_input_requirements.why: Pads/buttons/header must project one coherent instrument state without inventing keybed lamps or losing connected-control meaning.

canonical_input_requirements.required: Sound identity perBassA/B, availability label and sample/engine status when relevant, read from allowed public identity interfaces; no synth coefficients needed.
canonical_input_requirements.why: HOME note content is stored-pattern activity, not measured audible engine output.

next_concrete_integration: Parent defines a canonical pattern/assignment/mute/transport fixture once, then binds HOME, SEQ, PARA, MIX, pad/button projection and Song interfaces to it.

Use retained actual four-kick frame for its qualified scenario. Use explicitly labelled source-authored test fixture for broader projection design, with no claim of new emulator execution or musical arrangement.
Inventory every existing data cue and direct control before changing layout; distinguish retained occupancy/velocity projection from a proposed note/slide view.
Incumbent Song helper owns bar editor/K5 contract. Existing reviewer admission and immutableR5 remain untouched. Parent owns anyR6 change/review/validation.
limits: No R5/source/Git/runtime edit, no new render/emulator/host/review/audio/device run, no new agent.
No private synth coefficient/header bytes retrieved.
No notes, per-hit velocities, slide flags or muted/cued captured state invented from pixels.
Saved note content is not proof of sounding/available engine output, probability outcome or musical success.
Reserved CP1 producer ownership remains intact; this is generic existing HOME source semantics and the Song interface, not replacement CP1 admission.
